subject: Skip phalanx detection for inactive viewers
description: `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_045/replay-014-session-0001.jsonl.zst` exposed a visibility-query divergence after frame 902 once the source-faithful phalanx right-chain traversal from #445 included inactive Soldier62: Original recorded 9 visibility queries while Rust recorded 14, with all five extra Rust queries owned by Soldier62 viewing PCs 103, 104, and 105. Original still follows the installed phalanx neighbour link, but `RHElementActorNPC::IsDetecting360Degrees` rejects an inactive or inside-building viewer or target before geometry and LOS (`original-code/RHelementactornpc.cpp:2884-2903`), while `IsDetecting180Degrees` likewise rejects an inactive viewer or target before geometry and LOS (`original-code/RHelementactornpc.cpp:2974-2982`, `3034-3035`). Commit `ce5bcdf38d64c476f5f106912b36d39dd619a0fd` carries each phalanx member's live active flag into the snapshot and applies that viewer guard to both detection variants without removing the member from the linked traversal. The focused `inactive_phalanx_member_is_traversed_without_detecting_enemies` regression passes: it supplies an otherwise visible, in-range target in both the persistent and detectable lists, marks the viewer inactive, and confirms that it contributes no enemy. A fresh optimized validation runner containing this commit and the subsequently committed unchanged #404 patch clears the frame-902 visibility-query frontier and the former frame-1162 Soldier62 `list_them` frontier, then first diverges independently after frame 1298 on ten PC99 melee/command fields: Original executes `SwordstrikeThrustA`/animation 67 while Rust remains in `MoveOk`/animation 304, with associated wait, increment, goal, and sprite differences. Same-save replay-003 remains unchanged at its independent frame-1191 five-field Projectile121 lifecycle frontier. Neither replay matches exact EOF.
